data.name: Annor
data.detailed_description:
Sulana, descendant of a buried city

Sulana, a young girl whose grandfather is from the city of Annor, was rocked by her stories during her childhood and always wanted to go there. However, her grandfather constantly refused to drive her, claiming that it was no longer possible. By becoming a young adult, she will steal one of the few objects that her grandfather had brought back from the city. A scepter, the only key to return to the city. She is there, gone into the desert, closer to the city than ever before...

Explore a city full of explosive objects.

Beware of your environment, in this city that seems abandoned, terrible creatures hide in the background, ready to explode. Move forward carefully, pay attention to your environment and don’t rush, or you might regret it...

A magic scepter

Use your magical powers to reveal the enemies around you and eliminate them. This scepter could therefore be your only solution to progress in the city. However, please note that this scepter is unstable...

data.short_description: Annor is a puzzle adventure where the player incarnate an explorer progressing through a city mined by hidden enemies to reach the stone of Annor. Illuminate your environment with your scepter to detect the keys of the puzzle and the threat in order to fight it.
